en: Black‑and‑white image showing a large late‑19th‑century neoclassical / historicist building along a tree‑lined street. The facade has rusticated corners, arched windows in the central risalit, pediments over some windows, and a modest towerlike central section. A wrought‑iron fence with gate separates the sidewalk from a small front garden. The street is broad and shaded by regularly planted trees. No visible text or caption appears on the image.
